name: evalbench
description: File-based benchmark harness for comparing LLM pipelines on a fixed case set, with cached runs, pluggable scorers, an LLM judge and bootstrap confidence intervals.
author: Direk Sethi

scripts.example: node bin/evalbench.js run naive --dir examples/dates --scorer exact && node bin/evalbench.js run numeric --dir examples/dates --scorer exact && node bin/evalbench.js run rules --dir examples/dates --scorer exact && node bin/evalbench.js leaderboard --dir examples/dates
